AuthMode.name: authMode
AuthMode.summary: selects the authorization mode for simulation
AuthMode.description: Specifies the authorization mode to use when simulating the transaction. The options are 'enforce' (enforces all authorization checks), 'record' (records authorization without enforcement), and 'record_allow_nonroot' (records authorization while allowing non-root invocations). If you omit it for an `InvokeHostFunctionOp`, the default depends on the operation's authorization entries: 'record' when it has none, and 'enforce' when it has at least one. You cannot use 'record' or 'record_allow_nonroot' when the operation already has authorization entries. Do not set this parameter for `ExtendFootprintTTLOp` or `RestoreFootprintOp`, because the server rejects it.
